caption:
How to turn a confusing policy page into a clear customer FAQ with AI

If customers keep asking things your policy already covers, the policy isn't the problem. The wording is.

Copy this:

"Rewrite this policy as a customer FAQ. Use the questions a customer would actually ask. Answer each in plain English, max 2 sentences. Keep every rule and number exactly as written. At the end, list anything unclear under 'Questions for the owner'. Policy: [PASTE POLICY]"

I tried it on an invented bakery's custom order policy. One long legal paragraph became 4 short answers, and it spotted that the policy never says how much the admin fee is.

Before you publish: check every number, answer the gaps, and keep the full policy linked below the FAQ.
